## Calculate the BaseEF and EF

```{r EF caluclation}
#Grain Agg
load("../Input/US_Direct_2018-2022_GrainAgg.RData") #SiteData

#Calculate the EF
Result <- N2OEF_direct(USData) 
summary(Result$Result_Prov_Crop$N2O.IEF) #median IEF = 0.006027, mean IEF = 0.006362
#write.csv(Result$Result_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Direct N2O_FSN_US_GrainAgg.csv",row.names = FALSE)


#Grain Split
load("../Input/US_Direct_2018-2022_GrainSplit.RData") #SiteData

#Calculate the EF
Result <- N2OEF_direct(USData) 
summary(Result$Result_Prov_Crop$N2O.IEF) #median IEF = 0.006065, mean IEF = 0.006546
#write.csv(Result$Result_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Direct N2O_FSN_US_GrainSplit.csv",row.names = FALSE)

```
